subject.title: feat(system-agent): give Ask OpenClaw ambient page context

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `openclaw.chat.context.page` as a supported cross-client Gateway protocol input for transient system-agent ambient context?
rationale: This is a new user-visible capability and public request shape, not a repair of an established broken contract; the implementation can be correct while the permanent protocol direction still requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve the bounded protocol seam
options.body: Accept the optional closed `context.page` field after exact-head real-path proof confirms it remains transient and backward compatible.

options.title: Keep page awareness UI-local
options.body: Decline the cross-client protocol expansion and require a narrower Control UI-specific approach if ambient route context is not intended as a general Gateway contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded protocol seam
recommendation.body: Accept the optional closed `context.page` field after exact-head real-path proof confirms it remains transient and backward compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history ties this contributor to the proposed Control UI, Gateway, and system-agent boundary changes.
